categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Modifies Tor control integration logic and logging in src/torcontrol.cpp and src/torcontrol.h.
categories.rationale: Suppresses recurring Tor control connection failure log spam introduced in v32 on default nodes without Tor running. The change eliminates roughly 18 lines per hour of spurious warnings and adds an informational log when an active onion service drops, providing worthwhile log hygiene.

categories.name: utils
categories.evidence: Utils explicitly excludes logging changes whose focus belongs to a specific functional area rather than shared infrastructure.
categories.rationale: Tor control logging behavior belongs to the P2P networking subsystem rather than general logging utilities.
